purpose: Fictional Luca in a detailed comic style: happy at slide entry, worried with a sweat drop after the first presentation click.
basePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: first state of an interactive character portrait in a university presentation, with an actual transparent background.
Subject: Luca, a fictional 20-year-old male second-year computer science student. Waist-up, three-quarter view turned slightly toward the viewer's left, full head and hair comfortably inside the frame, both shoulders and both hands visible. A slim young adult with wavy medium-short chestnut brown hair, brown eyes, light warm Mediterranean skin, a small natural nose, no beard. He wears an unbranded deep petrol teal zip hoodie over a cream T-shirt. He casually holds one closed cream textbook at his waist with both hands.
Expression for this first state: happy, relaxed and confident, friendly natural smile, relaxed eyebrows, bright open eyes.
Style: polished contemporary European graphic-novel / comic illustration, noticeably more detailed than a flat pictogram: precise expressive facial anatomy, individual hair locks, careful hands, clothing seams and believable folds, confident fine ink contours and restrained two-to-three-tone cel shading. Mature and approachable university student, not chibi, not a child, not photorealistic, not a 3D render. Clean silhouette readable on a dark charcoal slide.
Composition: portrait 2:3 framing; character fills most of the canvas with modest transparent margins and no floor or background. Keep the exact pose easy to reuse for a second worried expression; all body, clothes and textbook positions will remain fixed in that state. Leave a small empty transparent margin near the upper-right of his hair for a later single comic sweat drop.
Palette: petrol teal hoodie, cream shirt and book, warm natural skin and chestnut hair; restrained sophisticated colors that work against #151318.
Background: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha, including around the head, shoulders and hands. Opaque fills inside the character and book. No rectangular backdrop, no colored cloud, no halo or drop shadow.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, icons, captions, watermarks or extra props. Do not add a sweat drop or fear symbols in this happy state.
